title: Watts 800M4 repair kits by size and failed component
description: Match a Watts 800M4 or LF800M4QT size band to the official bonnet, check, vent-float, rubber, seat, or total repair kit.
summary: The 800M4 repair family repeats across size bands, but the part-number suffix and eligible model designation change. Select the exact band before comparing kit scope.
statusNote: Watts publishes 800M4FR, 800M4QT, and LF800M4 variants. Confirm the complete body label because some retrofit, freeze-sensor, and repair kits have narrower compatibility.
diagramAlt: Pressure vacuum breaker showing bonnet, vent float, check assembly, and test cocks
identifiers: The full label may include 800M4QT, LF800M4QT, 800M4FR, or LF800M4FR.
A bonnet kit, vent-float kit, and check kit repair different assemblies.
Retrofit and freeze-sensor kits are not interchangeable with internal repair kits.
